correctness.rationale: The proof derives explicit characteristic formulas for private-color peeled parts, constructs an explicit bisimulation of same-colored vertices remaining in the 2+-part core, and matches them to count the exact atoms. The necessary sequential witnesses give q>=max_i(n_(i)+i-1), and a matching suffix-palette labeling proves sufficiency. Induction over a chain of supports gives the sharp k-1 depth boundary. Direct finite checks cover 19,607 supports, 274 rank cases, 13 sharp-depth instances, and 600 direct algebra closures; no finite extrapolation is treated as proof.

value.rationale: The task of selecting the smallest number of predicates that define each state is natural in modal logic and finite Boolean modal algebras. This complete multipartite classification yields an exact constructive rank for arbitrary part sizes, a quotient formula for every coloring even without generation, and a dimension-independent sharp depth bound; these are structural results beyond routine reformulations of bisimulation or isolated small-case counts.
